repairs.quote: Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them 20/25/30% Move Speed for 8/10/12 seconds. Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by 0.5 seconds. Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.
